description:
One proposal in full: its claim, its link, the tally, its phase, and what concluding it now would decide.

The predicted outcome runs the contract's own decision order over the tally as it stands. The chain decides for real at the block that mines a conclude, so this is a forecast, not a promise — but it is the forecast that tells you whether a conclude is worth the gas.

Read-only, no wallet needed.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

side.description: Which legion: "yes"/"bonded" argues the coins entered a PoX-5 bond, "no"/"idle" argues they did not.
